config_entries.label: Sensor ID
config_entries.description: The temperature sensor that already carries the same offset, so its state is the corrected temperature. Pointing it at the raw temperature gives a wrong humidity without any warning.

config_entries.label: Temperature Offset
config_entries.description: The offset that was applied to the temperature sensor, in the sensor's unit.

config_entries.label: Use Fahrenheit
config_entries.description: Set to `true` when the temperature sensor reports °F. Defaults to `false`.
